purpose: Water animation/advancement and rain lifecycle over borrowed existing level/particle state, with ordered native writes, random requests and image-cell rendering/restoration decisions. Synchronous pixel transactions retain the existing physical service implementation.

inputs: All scalar water fixed/pixel/previous Y, raw frame and retained byte position words; countdown, phase and pending bytes; full increment word, row-stride byte and direction byte. No positivity, initialized-cache or Boolean-phase restriction.
Selected particle current/previous image-cell position and full modulo word.193 physical slots, descending iteration with original wrapping word counter.
Respawn consumes exactly one closed RNG draw with wrapping320+surface bound, including zero. Reply is admitted as any16-bit word; actual RNG recurrence/state remains with its accepted owner.

Frame cursors borrow five arbitrary color bytes and a raw eight-bit initial mask. Frame recipes0..2 each have320 cells; constructor/valid continuation state and ordinary disjoint input/output storage are required.
outputs: Ordered global/selected-particle stores, background mark/restore requests, frame-tail key/position, one RNG request, conditional respawn request, image-cell draw/copy requests, and plane-mask changes.

State and pixel selection follow the native results; the bridge checks exact field/address/width/value, origin, mask, frame key and complete normal consumption. Working projection is checked at matching pre-service cuts.
effects: Water mark is one fixed pixel-service transaction: descending80 live background reads/writes of40h under GC8=40h/GC3=10h, followed by prescribed resets. Native chooses its wrapping relative position; the service owns live latches and inherited VGA configuration.

Rain restore copies live physical A000 background cells to draw cells under GC bit mask0, leaving inherited sequencer map mask and write/read modes intact; final maskFF. Rain draw and both restore routines deliberately use physical A000 and page offsets, whereas water surface tails and marking honor full original segment:offset pointers.

All real RNG calls keep original near return words and state updates. Outer loop/index helpers preserve descending order and signed post-test, including an iteration before a negative initial counter is tested.

The three frame streams emit exactly320 ordered pixels and three raw-mask shifts plus finalF. Actual physical byte writes, port setup/teardown, stack restoration and machine flags stay in the checked service/ABI shell.
preconditions: Ordinary disjoint native state, input resources, data/code and stack; synchronous pixel services do not modify the projected simulation arrays/globals. No asynchronous mutation between import/publication/service cuts.

Native bridge admission: canonical code/data segments and even selected particle index<386. Whole rain loops use native slot operations only when their wrapping initial index is<386. Other bindings/index domains retain the complete literal shell; full-word counter arithmetic itself is proved independently.

Water draw preparation admits full scalar words in the native API. Bridge dispatch uses native preparation when the doubled frame key resolves to the expected registered frame0/1/2; unknown/corrupt table targets keep literal compatibility before partial publication. Aliases8000h..8002h are retained when their doubled key is valid.

Pixel/frame/page resources and real callees keep their existing contracts. No safety/clipping interpretation is invented for malformed overlapping resources. Direct frame tails require their original saved-DS tail frame; live colors and raw mask are not normalized.

borrowed: WaterSurfaceStep, row stride, direction and shared surface value; rendering pages, live pixel/latch state and color operands; existing random state through its service.
Other readers retain their original field bindings. No actor scratch alias, passenger phase field, player position/cache, input or audio state is owned here.

After a mark service the native marked continuation updates pending before the rectangle tail; before a respawn tail the parent particle snapshot agrees, then the child owns its own poststate. assumptions: B uses actual compiled C bodies, small ordinary-RAM normalization, one arbitrary physical selected slot, arbitrary observation index plus total count, independent native/resource byte frames and inactive-input dependence. All scalar boundaries remain symbolic.

The80-cell water mark and rectangle/frame pixel services are synchronous boundaries with unchanged checked literal implementations. Their endpoints may supply arbitrary shared register/flag results subject to their data/segment/stack frames; caller proofs do not substitute a model of VGA internals.

Full-word initial/index/SUB-post-test and masked-shift properties, arbitrary-slot output/frame properties and checked complete outer loops compose the physical193-slot scans. The native frame event transition, every320-cell recipe and constructor are separately checked; fixed four-plane/80-cell shell loops are retained literally.

RNG bound/selected slot are checked and supplied from native results. Its existing ordinary-CS-state/disjoint-stack contract discharges recurrence and data frames; real RNG order/count is independently compared with L0, including loader prewarming.

Pixel services and complete-loop/session composition have independent C/D evidence. No global formal machine/device equivalence, arbitrary corrupted-resource alias theorem or overall A status is claimed.
eliminated: Ordinary native code has no Regs, addresses, memory accessors, ports, dispatch or stack layout. Relative image cells retain required word arithmetic; the platform supplies their physical mapping.

No mode/level-entry reset or new owner for shared water Y, pending/frame history or dry-level modulo words is introduced. No clipping, positive-delay saturation, normalized modulo input, extra random draw or retry is introduced.
retained: Pending nonzero clears and restores without advancing. Otherwise save previous pixel Y, XOR the full phase byte with1 and increment only if the result is zero; negative wrapped fixed-Y result clamps to zero only on that increment path. SAR5 and pixel equality are raw words. A changed row marks background, decrements pending0 toFF and restores; the following pending call restores again for the alternate page.

DEC8/JNS countdown:80h becomes7Fh without reload, zero becomesFFh then reloads6. Expiry decrements the frame word and replaces a signed-negative result with2. Doubling the raw frame and page-cell additions wrap.

Advance and restore begin at2*(surface+1), draw at2*surface; every loop is do/SUB/JNS. Extra last particles and wrapped/negative initial counters remain literal. Loader initializes193 current/previous cells but leaves dry-level modulo words stale.

Rain adds192 cells, plus96 on even slot parity; horizontal drift is(direction-1)*2-1, repeated twice or three times. TEST00FCh ignores high bits before modulo&3. Boundary comparison is unsigned against the retained WaterSurfaceByteOffset, not recomputed from current Y.

Respawn always draws once: values<320 spawn at top; other values subtract320 and use left/right edge according to exact direction==1. Only the low vertical byte participates in row-stride multiplication. Random bound zero still advances the closed generator.
Rain drawing uses286 count masking&31, then an eight-bit1<<count or zero; full modulo words are not normalized before this operation. All cell/page additions wrap, no clipping.

Water mark reads screen cells before writing and inherits map mask/write/read mode. Rain restore reads background even with map mask0; it refreshes all four latches and copies only enabled planes. Background/draw page segments are deliberately ignored by rain operations. The last read owns final latches.
